objective: Fixed original risk per position; cumulative net R
time_be_rule: Eligible25minutes after entry excluding entry candle; check each5m close. Wait if fee-cover stop cannot be placed; never force loss close; never loosen stop.
rsi_rule: RSI14 SAR.02/.02/.2, strong SAR threshold30/70; opposite confirmed close strictly after entry. Reduce20percent of original quantity only when that close's per-unit PnL exceeds round-trip cost. Losing diamonds consume no slot. Fifth qualifying diamond exits all.
same_time_priority: Resting stop, then terminal H1 reversal/boundary exit, then RSI reduction. Original15m5R4ATR runner unchanged.
comparison_clock: All six arms use identical1m execution candles; original5m baseline is separately compared, not silently mixed.
selection: 2024-only cumulative netR chooses an arm; inspect2025/2026. Wholehistory best descriptive. Known historical research.
second_rule: Skip the first opposite confirmed diamond after entry regardless of profit; start fee-positive original20percent reductions at the second or later, maximum five reductions.
